req.title: Return POST request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to POST /post with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that POST /post returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with a form-encoded body, (2) verify the positive path with a JSON body, (3) verify that wrong HTTP methods return non-200 (negative path), (4) verify boundary conditions such as empty body and query-string args alongside POST, and (5) assert exact key presence and values to kill constant/key-name mutations. Each test imports the Flask app in-process and uses test_client().

tests.name: test_post_form_data_returns_200_with_all_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body containing key=value
expected: JSON body contains exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
form field reflects submitted key-value pair
data field is empty string (form body consumed by form parser)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: JSON body reflecting POST payload; HTTP 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_form_data_returns_200_with_all_keys():
    r = client.post('/post', data={'mykey': 'myvalue'},
                    content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys
    assert body['form'] == {'mykey': 'myvalue'}
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['args'] == {}
    assert body['files'] == {}
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert 'post' in body['url']

test_post_form_data_returns_200_with_all_keys()

tests.name: test_post_empty_body_returns_200_with_empty_fields

expected: url, headers, origin keys are present

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_empty_body_returns_200_with_empty_fields():
    r = client.post('/post', data=b'', content_type='application/octet-stream')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['args'] == {}
    assert body['files'] == {}
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}

tests.name: test_post_response_key_set_is_exact_no_extra_no_missing
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with a form body
Inspect the exact set of top-level keys in the JSON response
expected: Exactly 8 keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin — no more, no fewer
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: JSON body must include url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_response_key_set_is_exact_no_extra_no_missing():
    r = client.post('/post', data={'x': '1'},
                    content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    keys = set(body.keys())
    required = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    missing = required - keys
    extra = keys - required
    assert missing == set(), f'Missing keys: {missing}'
    assert extra == set(), f'Extra keys: {extra}'
    assert len(keys) == 8

test_post_response_key_set_is_exact_no_extra_no_missing()

tests.name: test_post_multipart_file_upload_reflects_files_field
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: POST to /post with multipart/form-data containing a file upload
expected: files field contains the uploaded file key
form field does not contain the file key
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: files key in JSON body reflecting POST payload
tests.executable:
from io import BytesIO
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_multipart_file_upload_reflects_files_field():
    file_content = b'hello file content'
    data = {'upload': (BytesIO(file_content), 'test.txt')}
    r = client.post('/post', data=data, content_type='multipart/form-data')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert 'upload' in body['files']
    assert 'upload' not in body['form']
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['args'] == {}

test_post_multipart_file_upload_reflects_files_field()

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_url_field_contains_post_path():
    r = client.post('/post')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert body['url'].endswith('/post')
    assert isinstance(body['origin'], str)

    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    assert len(body['headers']) > 0

tests.name: test_post_content_type_header_reflected_in_headers_field
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: headers field contains Content-Type key with value application/json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-004: headers key in JSON body reflecting POST payload
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_content_type_header_reflected_in_headers_field():
    r = client.post('/post',
                    data=json.dumps({'k': 'v'}),
                    content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    headers = body['headers']
    assert isinstance(headers, dict)
    ct_key = next((k for k in headers if k.lower() == 'content-type'), None)
    assert ct_key is not None, 'Content-Type header not found in response headers field'
    assert 'application/json' in headers[ct_key]

test_post_content_type_header_reflected_in_headers_field()
